description: A tag that is the mark up to case and separators is reported as a misspelling, not read as an unrelated tag.

diagnostics.message: `@NoThrow` is not a mark: the mark is spelled `@nothrow`, and this differs from it only in case and separators, so it is read as an unrelated tag and enforces nothing. Spell it `@nothrow`.
`@NOTHROW` is not a mark: the mark is spelled `@nothrow`, and this differs from it only in case and separators, so it is read as an unrelated tag and enforces nothing. Spell it `@nothrow`.
`@no-throw` is not a mark: the mark is spelled `@nothrow`, and this differs from it only in case and separators, so it is read as an unrelated tag and enforces nothing. Spell it `@nothrow`.
`@no_throw` is not a mark: the mark is spelled `@nothrow`, and this differs from it only in case and separators, so it is read as an unrelated tag and enforces nothing. Spell it `@nothrow`.
